role_summary: Director-level strategic technology leader defining and governing enterprise and solution architecture across Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group. Responsible for aligning technology solutions with business objectives, scalability, security, and integration, while also hands-on in solution and integration architecture. Collaborates with business and IT teams to deliver future-resilient solutions leveraging advanced AI technologies.
must_have_requirements: Deep expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks
Proven experience in solution design and systems integration
Strong stakeholder engagement and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
Hands-on experience with cloud and on-premises environments
Knowledge and applied experience with advanced AI technologies
Strategic thinking with ability to govern architecture across an organization
Excellent communication and presentation skills for executive-level interactions
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience with AI/ML frameworks and tools
Knowledge of hotel systems (PMS, CRS, CRM)

scoring_criteria.name: Enterprise Architecture Strategy
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core responsibility to define and govern enterprise architecture, ensuring alignment with business goals and strategic direction.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Case studies of enterprise-wide architecture transformation
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: If lacking formal EA experience, highlight solution architecture in complex environments.

scoring_criteria.name: Solution Design & Integration
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Hands-on role designing and delivering integrated solutions across applications, data, and infrastructure.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Look for compensation if no direct integration experience; emphasize related system design.

scoring_criteria.name: Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Need to handle both cloud and on-premises environments, ensuring scalability and security.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: If no cloud exposure, stress on-premises and willingness to upskill.

scoring_criteria.name: AI & Advanced Technologies
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: JD specifically mentions driving innovation with advanced AI technologies.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: If AI is limited, show foundational knowledge and eagerness to apply.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Job requires close collaboration with BSLs and TALs, translating business needs into technical solutions.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Highlight any experience in requirement gathering and stakeholder management.

scoring_criteria.name: Delivery & Engineering Excellence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Hands-on delivery and engineering support, proactive problem-solving.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: If more strategy than hands-on, emphasize deliverable-focused roles.

scoring_criteria.name: Technical Leadership
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Director-level role requires leadership in setting technology direction and guiding teams.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Showcase any leadership role, even if not formal.

scoring_criteria.name: Communication & Presentation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must articulate complex architecture to non-technical stakeholders and executives.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: If not documented, look for reports or whitepapers.

scoring_criteria.name: Hospitality Domain Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Understanding of hotel operations and systems is a plus, though not mandatory.
evidence_type_to_look_for: Knowledge of hotel PMS, CRM, booking engines
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: If none, emphasize transferable skills from other industries.

scoring_criteria.name: Digital Transformation & Innovation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Need for future-resilient solutions and innovation, aligned with luxury brand.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Show any innovative projects or forward-thinking mindset.

summary_focus: Strategic enterprise architecture leadership with hands-on solution delivery
Proven ability to align technology with luxury hospitality business goals
Expert in systems integration and future-proofing with AI technologies
Collaborative leader bridging business and IT stakeholders
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim direct luxury hotel experience if not true; emphasize transferable architecture skills
Do not overstate AI expertise unless concrete projects exist; use words like 'exploring' or 'foundational' if needed
Do not exaggerate cloud certifications if not held; mention cloud experience without specific titles

cover_letter_guidance.tone: Professional, confident, and forward-thinking, demonstrating passion for luxury service and technology innovation.
cover_letter_guidance.positioning: As a strategic technology leader who combines architectural vision with hands-on delivery, ready to elevate Mandarin Oriental's digital landscape.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If lacking hospitality experience, highlight transferable skills from other high-touch service industries
If AI experience is limited, express eagerness to leverage existing skills for AI-driven innovation
Acknowledge any gaps in cloud infrastructure by showing proactive learning or related projects
